High Res MS._description: Optimized for high-resolution MS2 (Orbitrap, TOF) when using ppm fragment tolerance

Low Res MS._description: Optimized for low-resolution MS2 (Ion trap) when using ppm fragment tolerance

Open Search._description: Open search: precursor tolerance ±500 Da without isotope errors, so peptides are identified with modifications the search did not include. See the Mass Shifts results page for the shifts and their Unimod matches.

Closed Search._description: Back to a standard (closed) search: the default precursor tolerance (20 ppm label-free, 4.5 ppm TMT) with 13C isotope errors 0/1.
